open_inventory:
def open_inventory() -> None:
    """인벤토리를 열고 패널이 표시될 때까지 기다린다."""
    button: object = find(name="InventoryButton")
    require(actionable(button), "Make the inventory button interactable.")
    click(button)
    wait_until(exists(selector("Canvas/InventoryPanel")), 5, "Check whether the inventory opened.")
check_damage:
def check_damage(enemy: object) -> None:
    """공격 전후 Enemy.Hp를 비교한다."""
    before: float = member(enemy, "Enemy.Hp")
    click(enemy)
    require(member(enemy, "Enemy.Hp") < before, "Check the attack target and damage.")
inspect_inventory:
from macros import open_inventory

def inspect_inventory() -> None:
    """인벤토리를 열고 화면 확인을 요청한다."""
    open_inventory()
    checkpoint("Inspect the inventory layout before continuing.")
    flag("Inventory inspected.")
    ask_verdict("Inventory items are readable and do not overlap.")
choose_action:
from macros import open_inventory, dismiss_dialogue

def choose_action() -> None:
    """현재 화면에서 가능한 인벤토리 또는 대화 작업을 고른다."""
    match decide("Which action fits this screen?", panel=under("Canvas")):
        case "open_inventory":
            open_inventory()
        case "dismiss_dialogue":
            dismiss_dialogue()

def hold_and_release() -> None:
    """Shift를 누른 상태에서 Space를 누르고 Shift를 놓는다."""
    hold_key("LeftShift")
    press_key("Space", 0.1)
    release_key("LeftShift")
